lines.zh: 我低着头走，顶骨沉甸甸
lines.en: I walk head-low, my skull dome heavy.
Two legs, one after another, each step solid.

lines.zh: 平原的草被我一排排踏倒
lines.en: I trample the plain's grass in rows.
I sway my head as I go.
That slope is gentle; I'll take it.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，不想磕到脑袋
lines.en: I avoid the rocks; no bumping my head.
Tail held up to keep my balance.
Three steps, then a pause.
The wind is from the side; I walk angled.

lines.zh: 这片草够高，能遮住我半身
lines.en: The grass is high enough to hide half of me.

lines.zh: 我的影子在草地上很长
lines.en: My shadow stretches long on the grass.
My herd is ahead; I catch up.
My steps thud on the ground.
After a while my neck aches.
I head for that stand of low trees.
My pace isn't fast, but never sloppy.

lines.zh: 我停下来，用前肢拨了拨草
lines.en: I stop and part the grass with a forelimb.

lines.zh: 走过泥地，脚印一个个很清楚
lines.en: Across the mud, my prints are clear one by one.
Head down, dome forward.

lines.zh: 我在看地上有没有嫩芽
lines.en: I'm checking the ground for shoots.
Standing still, my head feels heaviest.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看了一下，又低下
lines.en: I glance up, then lower my head again.
Someone's far off; I don't move.
I bump the trunk beside me.
Leaves settle on my dome.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖脖子，把叶子甩掉
lines.en: I shake my neck and throw them off.

lines.zh: 风里有青草和泥的味道
lines.en: The wind smells of grass and mud.
I chew slowly; my throat works.

lines.zh: 这块石头不错，能当磨头的地方
lines.en: This stone would do for rubbing my head.
I squint; the sun is straight overhead.
I lower my tail to the ground.
It's quiet enough to hear insects.
I'll wait for them to move on first.

lines.zh: 头又沉下来了，我换脚站
lines.en: My head sinks again; I switch feet.
Hold still; let me look at you.
You're thin — not much to butt.
I square my dome at you.
Your shadow covers me.
Care to try this skull of mine?
I don't like being looked down on.
There's an old wound on my neck; don't touch.
You're a little close.

lines.zh: 我低头吃了口草，才抬起来
lines.en: I take a bite of grass before looking up.
Your hands smell like fruit.
I tilt my head to see how you move.
Stand back and we'll both be fine.
The pain makes me shake my head.
I back away, grumbling low.
That landed on my neck.
My dome is fine; the rest of me isn't.
I'm not steady on my feet.
I pant, and the grass trembles.
I'll remember who struck me.
Blood drips onto the grass.
I tuck my neck to guard my flank.
It hurts, but I won't run first.
Leaves or fruit?
I know that smell.
Set it down and I'll come slowly.
I lift my head, and my dome goes with it.
Don't hold it too high; I can't reach.
Before eating, I need to smell it properly.
These teeth are for grinding plants.
You step back; I step closer.
One bundle is enough; I'm not greedy.
A sweetness drifts over.

lines.zh: 我想吃，但要等你手放下
lines.en: I want it, but wait till your hand is down.
I sniff, then draw my neck back.
Easy now, don't wave it.
One bite, then I'm off.

lines.zh: 你留着也好，我自己找得到
lines.en: Keep it if you like; I can find my own.

lines.zh: 草尖上有露水，比你的更香
lines.en: Dew on the grass smells better than that.
You bumped into me — watch it.
I take half a step back, unwilling.

lines.zh: 撞我之前，先看我头上这块骨。
lines.en: Before you charge, look at the bone on my head.

lines.zh: 这块地太窄，我们错不开
lines.en: Too narrow here for both of us.

lines.zh: 我顶了一下你的腿，只是提醒
lines.en: I nudge your leg, just a reminder.
I'll go around; don't crowd me.

lines.zh: 你的靴子撞得我骨头响
lines.en: Your boot made my bones clack.
Steady — don't push.
I shake my head and plant my feet.
Move aside; I'm coming through.
Your dome is darker than mine.
Let's walk a stretch side by side.
I touch my dome to yours.
That was gentle — not a fight.
When you lower your head, I understand.
There's grazing enough here for both.
I'll keep watch; you sleep first.
Call once and I'll hear you.

lines.zh: 我们往南走吧，那边草嫩
lines.en: Let's go south; the grass is tender there.
The season is short; we'd best hurry.
This fruit fell at my feet.

lines.zh: 我低头找，顶骨挡住视线。
lines.en: I lower my head; my dome blocks the view.

lines.zh: 地上这几颗，我一颗颗捡
lines.en: I pick up these few, one at a time.
The one I dropped is still rolling.

lines.zh: 我低头找，顶骨挡住视线
lines.en: I search low, my dome blocking the view.
It isn't grass, but it'll do.
I push it against a stone.
You dropped it? Then it's mine.
My mouth is full; I mumble.
I shake my head and crumbs fall.
Something's in the grass over there.
I raise my head and face it.
Footsteps — more than one.
It watches me; I watch it.
This ground is mine.

lines.zh: 我的顶骨朝着它的方向
lines.en: My dome points its way.
One more step and I charge.
I lower myself, ready.
It's circling, trying to get behind me.
I won't back off; the grass here is best.
It stays; so do I.
I face it square and drop my head.
My feet scrape the ground twice.

lines.zh: 我低下头，把骨顶对准它。
lines.en: I lower my head and aim my dome at it.
When it hesitates, I advance.
I'll aim this at its legs.
My breathing deepens.
It hasn't moved; I wait.
My herd backs off to give me room.
I fix on its knee.
Head down — I charge.
My dome slams into its leg.
That one it will remember.
I turn the moment after impact.
Bone on bone — a loud crack.
Two steps back, then charge again.
I don't bite. I only butt.
It staggers back from the blow.
My dome is numb from it.
Come again and I'll hit harder.
I rise out of the grass.
My head is heavy; I nearly topple.
Sunlight falls on my dome.
My call comes out weak; my throat is new.
The grass stands taller than I am.
I lower my head and look for food.
Wind comes; I plant my feet.
Others of my kind graze in the distance.
It's flat here — good for walking.
I test my legs; I can run.

lines.zh: 我这颗头骨，专门用来撞。
lines.en: This skull of mine is built for ramming.
My first look up: the sky is very blue.

lines.zh: 背上一着火，我往泥里滚
lines.en: My back catches fire; I roll in the mud.

lines.zh: 落地时膝盖一软，趴下了
lines.en: My knees gave on landing; I went down.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我抬不起头
lines.en: Water pours in; I can't lift my head.
A bang, and I'm thrown aside.
Something lodges in my shoulder.
A strange force locks my legs.
Too little grass; my legs feel weak.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我顶骨嗡嗡响
lines.en: Lightning strikes; my dome rings.

lines.zh: 脚下没了地面，我一直坠
lines.en: The ground is gone and I keep falling.
